0.name: Normal
0.meaning: No AI-credit, funding, supply-chain or macro indicator is flagged. Routine monitoring.

1.name: Watch
1.meaning: At least one AI indicator is on watch or tripped, or a leading macro indicator (yield curve, Baa spread) is flagged. Stress is visible in some markets, but nothing has been confirmed in broad equity prices or credit.

2.name: Confirmed
2.meaning: Two or more AI indicators are tripped and broad markets agree: the S&P 500 is below its 10-month average, or the Baa or high-yield spread has tripped. Historically this is where stress has stopped being isolated.

3.name: Severe
3.meaning: Level 2 conditions have held for two consecutive month-ends and credit is breaking: Oracle at junk, AI lab funding tripped, or the high-yield spread at 5.0 or above.

sp500_trend.name: S&P 500 vs 10-month average
sp500_trend.trigger_text: Month-end close below 10-month SMA (tripped); latest close below it intra-month (watch)
sp500_trend.tripped_phrase: S&P 500 month-end close below its 10-month average

yield_curve.name: Yield curve (10y minus 3m)
yield_curve.trigger_text: T10Y3M below 0 for 5+ consecutive daily readings (tripped); 0 to +0.25 (watch)

baa_spread.name: Baa corporate spread (BAA10Y)
baa_spread.trigger_text: At or above 2.13 or up 50 bp from 12-month low (tripped); up 30 bp (watch)

hy_oas.name: High-yield spread (HY OAS)
hy_oas.trigger_text: At or above 5.0 or up 100 bp in 3 months (tripped); up 50 bp (watch)

claims.name: Initial jobless claims (4-wk avg)
claims.trigger_text: 20% or more above 52-week low (tripped); 15% or more (watch)

ai_credit.trigger_text: Tripped: Oracle at junk, or CDS 300 bp+ sustained, or a CoreWeave failed issue, or a second neocloud bond under 80. Watch: CDS 250 bp+ or CoreWeave bond under 80.
ai_credit.watch_phrase: AI credit stress (CoreWeave distressed, Oracle CDS near record)

hyperscaler_capex.trigger_text: Tripped: two or more big-four capex cuts in a quarter, or next-year growth guidance under 20%.

ai_lab_funding.trigger_text: Tripped: a down round, a pulled or broken IPO, or a secondary discount of 20% or more.

dram_prices.trigger_text: Tripped: contract prices down quarter on quarter, or spot down 10% in 3 months. Watch: memory equities down 30%+ from peak (they lead prices by 3 to 9 months).

gpu_rental.trigger_text: Tripped: H100 1-year index under $1.70/hr, or down 15% in 3 months.

lease_cancellations.trigger_text: Tripped: two or more hyperscalers cancelling 500 MW or more of leases.

earnings_revisions.trigger_text: Tripped: three straight months of net negative revisions, or forward EPS 3% below peak.

tsmc_revenue.trigger_text: Tripped: 3-month average YoY growth under 20%, or two straight monthly drops of 5%+.
